query: Someone Worth Losing To The crowd parts. Lyra Vaneshade is in the chalk, gloves off, hair tied back. "So it's true." Her voice carries over the whole cellar. "You're throwing your talent away down here, in front of drunks. Fine. Then you'll lose it to someone worth losing to." Somebody is already shouting odds on House Vaneshade. Fight her Her flame breaks on your last spell and she goes down on one knee in the chalk, in front of all of them. She stands, white to the lips. "Again," she says. "In the hall. Where it counts." The crowd will be talking about it for a term. She takes you apart in four exchanges, beautifully. Then she walks you up the steps herself, holding your elbow. "Now you know," she says, "where you belong. It isn't here." Walk out with her You step out of the chalk and offer her your arm. The cellar boos you both up the steps. Outside, in the cold, Lyra lets go of your arm and doesn't say thank you. She does walk you all the way back.

Lyra Notices
Lyra's eyes go straight to the ashwood wand in your hand. "Ashwood," she says. "Duellist's wood. Mother says it's for people who can't win on talent." She draws her family's pale wand. "One bout. Ashwood against Vaneshade. Unless you're shy."
